dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts surviving family members of certain deceased members of the Armed Forces.
dimensions.evidence: Any individual who is a survivor entitled to... a death gratuity... or dependency and indemnity compensation

dimensions.assessment: Provides recipients with free lifetime access to federal recreational lands and national parks.
dimensions.evidence: lifetime National Parks and Federal Recreational Lands Passes for family members of members of the Armed Forces who lost their lives

dimensions.assessment: Reduces or foregoes recreation fee revenue for the federal government from these specific individuals, though exact amounts are unstated.
Makes a narrow addition to the existing Federal Lands Recreation Enhancement Act eligibility criteria.
dimensions.evidence: Section 805(b)(2) of the Federal Lands Recreation Enhancement Act (16 U.S.C. 6804(b)(2)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Provides permanent lifetime passes to eligible individuals.
dimensions.evidence: lifetime National Parks and Federal Recreational Lands Passes

missing_information: The number of eligible survivors and the total financial cost of waived fees are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Extends eligibility for lifetime National Parks and Federal Recreational Lands Passes to survivors of Armed Forces members who died on active duty or during training.
